profileSupport_modelsEmpty.zh: 请先描述你遇到的问题。

profileSupport_modelsTooLong.en: The message is over 2,000 code points. Shorten it and submit again.
profileSupport_modelsTooLong.zh: 正文超过 2000 码点，请精简后再提交。

profileSupport_modelsUnsafeCharacters.en: The message has control or invisible characters (such as line breaks or direction marks). Remove them and submit again.
profileSupport_modelsUnsafeCharacters.zh: 正文含有控制字符或不可见字符（例如换行、方向控制符），请删除后再提交。

profileSupport_screenHint.en: Describe the problem. Never enter a private key, recovery phrase or code
profileSupport_screenHint.zh: 描述你遇到的问题；不要填写私钥、助记词或验证码

profileSupport_screenSubtitle.zh: 提交于 {relativeTime} · 还没有回复

profileSupport_screenSupportCapabilityBl.en: Support tickets aren't available right now

profileSupport_screenSupportEscalationTe.en: Replies within {responseWindowHours} hours. For urgent issues, say so in the ticket.
profileSupport_screenSupportEscalationTe.zh: {responseWindowHours} 小时内回复；紧急问题请在工单正文里写明。

profileSupport_screenSupportEscalationTe.en: Replies within {responseWindowHours} hours on business days. For urgent issues, say so in the ticket.
profileSupport_screenSupportEscalationTe.zh: 工作日 {responseWindowHours} 小时内回复；紧急问题请在工单正文里写明。

profileSupport_screenSupportMoreTicketsB.en: Only the latest page is shown; older tickets can't be viewed yet.
profileSupport_screenSupportMoreTicketsB.zh: 目前只显示最新的一页，更早的工单暂时看不到。

profileSupport_screenSupportScamNoticeBo.en: Anyone who asks for your private key, recovery phrase or code in a DM is a scammer. Report them.
profileSupport_screenSupportScamNoticeBo.zh: 任何私聊索要私钥、助记词或验证码的都是诈骗，请直接举报。

profileSupport_screenSupportTicketDetail.en: Support hasn't replied to this ticket yet; replies will show above.
profileSupport_screenSupportTicketDetail.zh: 客服还没有回复这张工单；有回复时会出现在上面。

profileSupport_screenSupportTicketsEmpty.en: After you submit, status and replies show here.
profileSupport_screenSupportTicketsEmpty.zh: 提交后，这里会显示状态与客服回复。

profileSupport_screenText10.en: A Launch asset that hasn't graduated can only be bought, and only through its own channel. A rejection comes with a specific error code, shown as-is on the trade page.
profileSupport_screenText10.zh: 未毕业的 Launch 资产只能买入，且只能走它自己的通道；被拒绝时会给出具体的错误码，交易页会原样显示。

profileSupport_screenText2.en: Power comes from the latest power snapshot: each registered asset's holding times its weight, not its price, listed line by line in the power breakdown. It counts holdings in wallets linked to your LOOP account; a community token counts only when it's bound to an approved community. The Mining page shows that snapshot's block and time.
profileSupport_screenText2.zh: 算力来自最近一次算力快照：每个已登记资产的持有数量乘以权重，不乘价格，在算力明细里逐行列出。按绑定到 LOOP 账号的钱包持仓计算；社区币须加入已通过审核的绑定社区才计入。挖矿页会显示那次快照的区块与时间。

profileSupport_screenText3.en: Why does my token have no weight
profileSupport_screenText3.zh: 为什么我的币没有权重

profileSupport_screenText4.en: Only registered assets count toward mining. Registration follows LOOP's registry, not whether a token has appeared in your wallet. Tokens bound to communities under review have no weight.
profileSupport_screenText4.zh: 只有已登记的资产才会计入挖矿。是否登记以 LOOP 的登记表为准，不以钱包里是否出现过为准。绑定待审核社区的币没有权重。

profileSupport_screenText5.en: How do I join a Launch

profileSupport_screenText6.en: Launch rounds, snapshots and limits are set by contract parameters. Until they're confirmed, the Launch page only shows existing round status and promises no allocation.
profileSupport_screenText6.zh: Launch 轮次、快照与限额由合约参数决定。参数确认前，Launch 页只展示已有的轮次状态，不承诺任何额度。

profileSupport_screenText7.en: How do I recover my account on a new phone

profileSupport_screenText8.en: Your account identity is held by Privy. Passkeys and multi-factor authentication can be turned on in Security Center, and automatic recovery is the default method; social recovery and private key export aren't open yet. Security Center shows the current status of each.
profileSupport_screenText8.zh: 账号身份由 Privy 保管。Passkey 与多因素验证可以在安全中心开启，自动恢复是默认的恢复方式；社交恢复与导出私钥还没有开放。安全中心会显示每一项的当前状态。

profileSupport_screenText9.en: Why was my bonding pool buy rejected
profileSupport_screenText9.zh: 内盘买入为什么被拒绝
